visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and round glasses, wearing a black T-shirt with a Godzilla graphic, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face, his mouth moving rapidly. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the man sitting at a dining table. He uses wooden chopsticks to eat green vegetables from a small white bowl, then lifts a bowl of multi-grain rice to show the camera. The background is a clean, modern kitchen area. (3) The man is now wearing a light pink oversized T-shirt and khaki shorts. He stands in a spacious living room with a wooden staircase and shelves filled with books. He walks toward the camera holding a white ceramic clay pot. A young girl with a ponytail in a white shirt and green shorts is visible in the background on the stairs. (4) The man places a digital scale on the floor and stands on it while holding the clay pot and a handheld weight reader. He looks at the screen with a tense, expectant expression. Close-ups show the digital display readings of 78.2kg and 24.7. (5) In a bright kitchen with white cabinets, the man, now in a grey T-shirt, prepares food. He shows a package of two fresh fish to the camera. He is seen cutting onions and grating ginger on a wooden cutting board with a silver grater. (6) The man pours various liquids (soy sauce, water, wine) from glass bottles into a bowl, then pours the mixture into a black frying pan containing sautéed onions. He carefully places the two whole fish into the simmering sauce. (7) He adds sliced yellow and red bell peppers to the pan and covers it with a glass lid. Later, he sprinkles white sesame seeds over the cooked fish in a white oval serving dish. (8) Back at the wooden table, the man eats the cooked fish using chopsticks. He looks into the camera, nodding and gesturing with his hands while describing the taste. He then drinks from a glass filled with ice and a brownish liquid. (9) The man is seen in a different room, wearing black athletic shorts and white sneakers, running in place. He stretches his arms behind his head and smiles while maintaining a jogging motion. The video ends with a yellow screen featuring a cartoon illustration of a boy and girl.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 粒米未進. (2) [Slogan]: Day64 100天瘦成皮包骨減肥計畫. [Subtitle]: 第一部過完片, 整臉青筍筍, 終於過完片, 現在快要10點, 粒米未進. (3) [Subtitle]: 好~因為實在太餓了, 稍微補充呢, 晚上有剩什麼我可以吃的就吃些什麼吧~. (4) [Variety]: (吃青菜). [Subtitle]: 吃一點點的飯. (5) [Variety]: (緩慢進食中). (6) [Slogan]: Day65 100天瘦成皮包骨減肥計畫. [Subtitle]: 昨天因為過完片實在太累了, 所以我吃完飯之後就馬上去睡覺了, 今天要迎來一個全新的開始, 量體重日. (7) [Variety]: (抖抖抖). (10) [Subtitle]: 沒錯! 飯都沒得吃, 怎麼可能會胖. (11) [Variety]: (會瘦吧!?). [Subtitle]: 噢~差一點. (12) [Variety]: (-0.7kg) 78.2kg. (13) [Variety]: (+0.4) 體脂24.7. [Subtitle]: 體脂沒有降欸, 內臟脂肪好像有降一點點, 還是45歲. (14) [Subtitle]: 抽兩個, 一樣留言分享. (15) [Variety]: (這個影片下面). [Subtitle]: 好~今天去拍一支片, 吃了一些不可言說的東西. (16) [Variety]: (拍片嘛!). [Subtitle]: 今天來簡單做個清冰箱料理. (17) [Subtitle]: 還剩下兩隻香魚啊. (18) [Variety]: (洋蔥切絲). [Subtitle]: 調個汁. (19) [Subtitle]: 薑泥, 一點酒, 味醂, 醬油, 加點水, 一點油, 蒜頭, 洋蔥, (全下), (大火翻炒). (20) [Subtitle]: 把洋蔥炒香, 加入料汁, 香魚擺進去. (21) [Variety]: (甜椒切絲). [Subtitle]: 切之前剩的甜椒, 丟進去, (悶一下). (22) [Subtitle]: OK~ (完成!). (23) [Subtitle]: 一點點胡椒, 芝麻, 燉煮黃魚, OK~ 不知道這個煮的魚肉怎麼樣. (24) [Subtitle]: 看起來是非常的軟嫩. (25) [Variety]: (吃一口看看). [Subtitle]: 用煮的多了很多複雜一點的香氣, 跟蔬菜的甜味其實蠻搭的, 好像蠻適合煮的欸. (26) [Variety]: (再吃一口). [Subtitle]: 嗯~很好吃欸. (27) [Variety]: (吃吃看甜椒). [Subtitle]: 好想配飯喔! 來一小碗的十穀米. (28) [Subtitle]: 啊~真是好吃, 就是用煮的要複製, 之前烤的那一隻可以把骨頭嚼一嚼. (29) [Variety]: (吃吃吃). (30) [Variety]: (喝個麥茶). [Subtitle]: 真不錯, 好~今天是有氧日, 就要來超慢跑吧. (31) [Variety]: (拉個筋). [Subtitle]: 有氧日現在都變超慢跑日了. (32) [Variety]: (跑跑跑), (繼續跑). [Subtitle]: 跑了大概40分鐘, 明天好像公司有活動, 早點睡覺了, 掰掰.
